step.label: Monitor production incidents
step.description: Detect and track equipment failures and safety incidents on the manufacturing floor to prevent disruptions.
step.useCase: Manufacturing supervisors need real-time visibility into incident metrics affecting production quality.

step.label: Qualify and certify material suppliers
step.description: Validate that incoming vendors meet material compliance standards and safety certifications before procurement.
step.useCase: Procurement teams require pre-screened, certified suppliers to ensure material quality and regulatory compliance.

step.label: Assess supplier performance metrics
step.description: Analyze vendor delivery performance, quality scores, and cost competitiveness to optimize procurement decisions.
step.useCase: Strategic buyers use vendor analytics to segment suppliers and negotiate better contracts.

step.label: Receive and inspect material shipments
step.description: Process inbound material receipts from qualified vendors and validate against purchase orders and quality standards.
step.useCase: Warehouse and inventory teams need to confirm material arrives complete, undamaged, and compliant.

step.label: Provision materials for engineering changes
step.description: Allocate materials and coordinate production item updates when engineering change orders are released.
step.useCase: Engineering and manufacturing planners must synchronize material availability with design modifications in real time.

step.label: Schedule production and assign machines
step.description: Optimize production order sequencing and machine allocation to maximize utilization and meet delivery dates.
step.useCase: Production schedulers need intelligent machine-to-order assignment that respects capacity and lead times.

step.label: Execute production runs on integrated machines
step.description: Coordinate machine production order execution and monitor real-time output against planned targets.
step.useCase: Plant floor operators require live integration with machines to track work-in-progress and adjust orders dynamically.

step.label: Report safety and compliance status
step.description: Document production safety incidents and regulatory compliance metrics for customer engagement and audit trails.
step.useCase: Quality assurance and compliance officers must communicate safety performance to customers and regulators.
